correctness.rationale: For every graph F(S) is antitone and S subset F²(S), giving F³=F and one-step entrance into period<=2. On the rook graph, an output square has no other active input in its row or column precisely when its row and column are both empty or it is an isolated active rook. This gives the disjoint full rectangle A×B plus complementary isolated partial matching I. The residual block can realize the prescribed empty rows/columns exactly for (p,q)=(0,0) or p,q>=1,p+q>=3. Nontrivial rectangles are recoverable as unique connected output components; all partial matchings occur except size a-1 on a square a=b. Count them by binomial matching factors; maximal independent matchings filling at least one side give E=max(a,b)!/|a-b|!, and the difference halves to 2-cycle orbits. Independent direct state enumeration produced (P,E,Q)=(4,2,1),(20,6,7),(42,12,15),(44,6,19),(182,24,79) for boards 2x2,2x3,2x4,3x3,3x4 and matched the combinatorial formulas. These finite checks are corroborative; the all-parameter structural proof covers the claim.
